Credit: written by
Author: A. Projectionist

# Act One

INT. THE REX CINEMA, PROJECTION BOOTH - NIGHT

Dust hangs in the beam of a 35mm projector. ELIAS VANCE, 60s, threads the final reel with surgeon's hands. The auditorium below is empty.

ELIAS
(quietly, to the machine)
One more time. Like we promised.

He flips the shutter. Light floods the booth.

CUT TO:

INT. THE REX CINEMA, AUDITORIUM - CONTINUOUS

Rows of vacant seats. On screen, a HOME MOVIE flickers: a birthday party, decades old. A young girl blows out candles.

MARA (O.S.)
You kept it.

Elias doesn't turn. MARA, 30s, stands in the aisle, out of breath.

ELIAS
You came back.

MARA
(beat)
You said the reel burns at midnight.

ELIAS
Then we watch it—

MARA ^
Together.

> THE END <
